name: ClickUp Docs
description: ClickUp Docs is ClickUp's collaborative document and wiki workspace for creating nested pages, connecting knowledge to tasks and hierarchy locations, and organizing shared team content. Docs support permissions, public links, comments, templates, protection, rich blocks, and Markdown or plain-text access through ClickUp's v3 API with documented formatting limits.
agentUseSummary: Do not create a separate ClickUp Docs connection or install. Use the canonical ClickUp provider for its currently approved bounded Workspace and task workflows. Relay does not search, read, create, import, export, edit, delete, share, protect, or administer Docs and pages until typed Docs actions are added to the canonical ClickUp provider under the same OAuth and Workspace authority.

blocked.label: Create a ClickUp Docs connection
blocked.description: Docs use the same ClickUp account, OAuth token, authorized Workspaces, permissions, API origin, and disconnect lifecycle as the canonical ClickUp provider.

blocked.label: Install duplicate Docs tools
blocked.description: Relay mounts supported ClickUp operations once through the canonical provider rather than publishing parallel credentials, policies, actions, and audit state.

blocked.label: Search or read Docs
blocked.description: Searching Docs, retrieving Doc metadata, listing page hierarchies, reading page content, and traversing nested pages are outside the current bounded ClickUp task contract.

blocked.label: Create or change Docs
blocked.description: Creating Docs or pages, importing content, editing names or content, reordering pages, archiving, restoring, or deleting Docs and pages is blocked.

blocked.label: Share or administer Docs
blocked.description: Public links, invitations, roles, visibility, hierarchy locations, protection, templates, wikis, comments, history, duplication, search indexing, embeds, and Workspace or plan administration remain outside this alias.

blocked.label: Import or export lossy content
blocked.description: Relay does not silently transform Docs through Markdown or plain text because ClickUp documents unsupported rich elements, embeds, views, inline formatting, layouts, comments, covers, icons, and wiki semantics.

blocked.label: Use private ClickUp interfaces
blocked.description: Sessions, cookies, passwords, verification codes, browser automation, scraping, undocumented endpoints, beta MCP, arbitrary Doc IDs, automatic unbounded traversal, and raw requests are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Use ClickUp
approvalProfiles.description: No separate ClickUp Docs action is enabled because Docs is a Workspace resource governed by canonical ClickUp authority.

runtimeSupport.description: No duplicate ClickUp Docs tools are mounted. OpenClaw uses canonical ClickUp only for its approved bounded Workspace and task workflows.
No duplicate ClickUp Docs tools are mounted. Hermes uses canonical ClickUp only for its approved bounded Workspace and task workflows.

providerSetup.blocker: ClickUp Docs is a product resource inside an authorized ClickUp Workspace, not a distinct provider identity or authorization surface. ClickUp's public v3 API can search and fetch Docs, retrieve page listings and bounded page content, create Docs and pages, and perform additional content operations with the same authorization token used for ClickUp. Doc and page permissions also inherit from Workspaces, hierarchy locations, tasks, views, and explicit sharing; public or private visibility can materially change exposure. Relay's canonical ClickUp V1 intentionally exposes eight bounded task tools and blocks administration, destructive or bulk work, arbitrary endpoints, and automatic pagination. A separate Docs card would duplicate OAuth and Workspace state, while an untyped or partial mount would omit sharing, hierarchy, rich-content loss, page lifecycle, and permission semantics.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep this product-mode slug non-installable and use canonical ClickUp only for its current explicit task operations. If Docs support becomes part of Relay's chosen ClickUp surface, extend the canonical ClickUp provider rather than this alias and freeze typed Workspace and Doc binding, bounded search and page depth, Markdown versus plain-text fidelity, payload sizes, page hierarchy, visibility defaults, Safe approvals and Dangerous behavior, public-sharing and inheritance rules, idempotency, archive and deletion policy, comments and collaboration, rate and plan limits, audit and redaction, and production acceptance.

evidence.supports: ClickUp documents Docs as collaborative documents and wikis integrated with tasks, templates, nested pages, permissions, public sharing, and Workspace locations.
ClickUp's v3 API searches Docs inside one Workspace with access filtering, parent and lifecycle filters, bounded page sizes, and cursor pagination.
ClickUp's v3 API retrieves one explicit Doc page as Markdown or plain text and warns that formatting cannot always match the product.
ClickUp's v3 API creates a Doc in one Workspace with an explicit parent, public or private visibility, and optional initial page.
ClickUp documents substantial Markdown and plain-text import and export limits across rich text, inline formatting, layouts, views, embeds, advanced blocks, covers, comments, icons, and wikis.

ClickUp documents plan-dependent private defaults, inherited task and location permissions, guest roles, public links, page sharing, duplication, search indexing, protection, and external invitations.
